_note: Seed registry for bytebikri ad adapters. VERIFY every value against each provider's current published terms before enabling — referral rates, payout thresholds and payout methods change frequently, and several fields here are the difference between a Nepali creator getting paid or not. Fields marked VERIFY are best-effort from secondary sources.

providers.name: bytebikri House Ads
providers._note: The floor of every slot. Ship this first. Never leaves a slot blank.

providers.name: Affiliate link (user-supplied)
providers._note: Rewrites the user's OWN outbound links. No domain ownership, no site approval, no ads.txt. The most permissive category and the first real adapter to build.

providers.name: PropellerAds
providers._note: Low threshold. VERIFY that PayPal is not the only low-threshold rail and that a listed method actually works for Nepal.

providers.name: Monetag

referral.source: Monetag/PropellerAds referral program — documents a lifetime 5% commission

providers._note: Explicitly documented as a LIFETIME referral commission — the strongest referral terms found. WARNING: crypto payout rails are not usable in Nepal.

providers.name: Adsterra

referral.duration: VERIFY (own page says no limit; a secondary source says 12 months)

providers.minPayoutNote: VERIFY — sources disagree: $5 via Paxum, $100 via PayPal. Threshold is per-method.
providers._note: 25-48h approval reported. minPayoutUsd is method-dependent — the low number only counts if the method is usable from Nepal.

providers.name: PopCash
providers._note: Highest referral commission found (10%), 80% revenue share. Verify before listing.

providers.name: Adcash
providers._note: $5 threshold via digital methods; $100 via wire.

referral.source: secondary comparison sources — $10 credit per referred publisher who earns $10

providers.name: Google AdSense
providers.blockedReason: requiresOwnDomain — a user cannot use a site they do not own. Domain-level approval and shared publisher code make this unusable as a per-user plugin on bytebikri subdomains. Requires AdSense for Platforms.
providers._note: Nepal: wire + check only, NO EFT, NO Hyperwallet. $100 minimum is a ~2 year wait for a small Nepali creator. Keep as a POWER USER option with a clear warning, not a default.

providers.name: Ezoic
providers.blockedReason: Per-site integration (JS/plugin/nameservers) plus MCM review per site. Not a per-user plug-in.

providers.name: bytebikri Direct (platform-sold)
providers._note: Your own campaigns from Nepali advertisers. The only adapter where bytebikri holds the money — and in Nepal, the highest CPM for Nepali traffic. Highest revenue priority when enabled.

nepalPayoutWarnings: PayPal has historically not supported RECEIVING funds in Nepal. A $5 threshold is worthless if PayPal is the only low-threshold rail.
Nepal prohibits cryptocurrency transactions. Do not surface crypto-only payout rails to Nepali users.
AdSense in Nepal: Wire transfer and Check only. No EFT, no Hyperwallet. $100 minimum.
Prefer providers whose usable method is Payoneer, wire, or a domestic NPR rail via bytebikri direct.
